messages:
owen: Hi team, day 1 questions - MDM installer on my personal Mac hangs at 'Verifying' for ages. VPN connects but internal services like ci.redwood.internal time out. Also curious: do I need FileVault on my personal laptop if I'm only doing local dev? I also got a phish-sim email but no details on the testing window. Who should I ping for each item?

kate-peopleops: Welcome @owen! Tagged IT and Security below. Quick note: if you want a company laptop instead of BYOD we can start provisioning today.

rachel-it: Hey @owen 1 For the MDM hang try this quick flow: 1) remove any old profiles (System Settings -> Profiles) 2) reboot 3) run the installer again. If it still stalls, run `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS \"mdm\"' --last 30m` and paste output. For the VPN -> ci timeout we default to split-tunnel OFF for devs accessing internal infra; make sure your client is the company build. Run `ping ci.redwood.internal` and `netstat -rn` and paste results. If urgent we can open a staging jumpbox.

ton y-security: FYI phish-sim is mandatory for new hires and usually runs for 10-14 days from the invite. Emails come from training@phishsim.io and subject begins with "Redwood Security Training". FileVault is required only if you will store production secrets or use prod creds locally. For BYOD used only for local non-prod work we accept a signed BYOD attestation + security checklist. If you need KMS read for a short spike, file a key-request and we can often grant ephemeral creds while review happens.

security-bot: Reminder: SEC101 security onboarding due in 7 days: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Check phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

owen: Thanks - quick follow-ups: 1) I removed old profiles and re-ran the installer, it progressed but failed with "Profile install: policy mismatch". 2) I tried ping and netstat -rn shows no route for 10.0.0.0/8 while VPN is connected. 3) I filed a key-request (KR-2026) for read-only KMS for staging - can security expedite?

rachel-it: For "policy mismatch" run `sudo profiles -P` and if you see an old redwood profile remove it with `sudo profiles -R -p <id>`. If the installer still errors, collect `Console.app` logs for MDM and DM them to us. For the missing route, try reconnecting to VPN after signing into Okta web once; if that fails we'll push a route policy. If you need immediate repo/ci access use the staging jumpbox: `ssh owen@staging-jump.redwood.internal`.

ton y-security: KR-2026 received. We'll mark for expedite and can provide ephemeral kms:read for 2 hours pending full review. Paste the request URL or ID and I'll tag it now. Also if you prefer a company laptop (faster prod access) reply here and we'll initiate provisioning.

owen: Pasting KR-2026 link now: https://redwood.example/internal/key-requests/KR-2026. Also please hold a laptop if provisioning is fast  prefer company-managed for prod later.

kate-peopleops: Noted. We'll start laptop provisioning and facilities will schedule pickup when ready. Welcome again and ping this thread if anything blocks first-week tasks.

owen: Great, thanks y'all! I'll send the MDM logs if the reinstall fails and test the jumpbox once KMS creds arrive.
